import numpy as np
y=dA_dt
edges=np.linspace(0.2,4.0,10)
for lo,hi in zip(edges[:-1],edges[1:]):
    m=(A>=lo)&(A<hi)
    if m.sum()<8: continue
    out=[]
    for basis in ['1/t,1,t2','1/t,1,t','1/t,1,t,t2']:
        cols={'1/t':1/t[m],'1':np.ones(m.sum()),'t':t[m],'t2':t[m]**2}
        X=np.c_[[cols[b] for b in basis.split(',')]].T
        c,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y[m],rcond=None)
        r=y[m]-X@c
        out.append((basis,np.round(c,3),'%.2e'%(np.sum(r**2)/np.sum((y[m]-y[m].mean())**2))))
    print(round(lo,2),round(hi,2),m.sum(),out)
